Mississippi State Senate
2026 Regular Session
YEAS AND NAYS. The yeas and nays being taken, the motion to table failed by
the following vote:
Yeas--Blackmon, Blount, Brumfield, Bryan, Butler, DuPree, Frazier, Gillespie
Isom, Hickman, Jackson, Mumford, Norwood, Pope, Simmons D. T. (12th), Simmons S.
(13th), Thomas, Turner-Ford. Total--17.
Nays--Barrett, Berry, Blackwell, Boyd, Chassaniol, Chism, DeBar, DeLano,
England, Fillingane, Hartness, Hill, Hopson, Johnson, Kirby, Ladner, McCaughn,
McLendon, McMahan, Michel, Parks, Rhodes, Seymour, Sparks, Suber, Tate, Taylor,
Thompson, Whaley, Wiggins, Williams, Younger. Total--32.
Absent and those not voting--Carter. Total--1.
Senator Harkins, who would have voted nay on S. B. No. 2828, announced a pair
with Senator Barnett, who would have voted yea.
